house.description: Authority for third-party road tests for school bus drivers amended, and technical changes made.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Transportation Finance and Policy

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Transportation Finance and Policy

additions: (24) third-party testing of school bus drivers
For purposes of this section, "road test" includes any necessary endorsement tests to operate a school bus.
(a) The commissioner may designate a service cooperative organized under section 123A.21 as a third-party testing program.

(b) A service cooperative that is designated as a third-party testing program may administer the road test to an employee of a school district that (1) is a member of the service cooperative, and (2) owns or operates school buses.
